history.content: idk why im even opening this lol. nothing really wrong. just kinda blah today
Hey — that “just kinda blah” sounds like it has a real shape, even if it’s hard to pin down. Does it feel more blank, flat, or just off?
ha you sound like my therapist. dunno. flat i guess? like the lights are on but theres nobody buying anything if that makes sense
That image makes sense — kind of flat and occupied, but not really engaged. Is it more like empty, disconnected, or just going through the motions?
going through the motions yeah. i opened my banking app this morning and just. felt nothing. like staring at a wall. numbers went up numbers went down whatever
That sounds really flat and automatic — like the numbers were there, but nothing was landing. Does it feel more like blankness, or more like being detached from it?

detached. i finally paid off the last of my credit card last week. like the thing i stressed about for two years. and i thought id feel something? relief? anything? nope. just shrugged and closed the app and made toast lol
That sounds detached and a little surprising — the payoff happened, but the feeling didn’t show up. Do you want to leave it there, or stay with what that “nothing” was like for you?

i mean i can stay i guess. its weird right? i spent so long bracing for the bad that when it was finally fine i forgot how to feel good. like the muscle stopped working or smth. been a bit like that with everything lately not just money
That sounds like a bigger flatness than just the money — almost like feeling good has gone out of reach lately. Is it more like shut down, foggy, or just hard to access?
foggy probably. anyway didnt mean to dump all that, was just gonna check the app for like a sec ha. but yeah. thanks. gonna go eat my toast before it gets cold
Foggy fits, and it makes sense that it showed up around something you’d waited on for so long. Go enjoy your toast — we can leave it here.
